'''Bon Sequors''' was a dashing [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who dressed in fine clothing and wore a blue cape. Sequors was sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]], but was not an official member. He had many friends who were, and as such tended to help them out as much as possible.<ref name="FC" />

Sequors pulled off a heist against the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Randar Dowellin]], stealing a valuable collection of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] artifacts including a rare [[Karltonian Fiskin]] [[Coin/Legends|coin]]. In an effort to avoid the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] sent after him, Sequors headed to the [[Farrimmer Cafe]] on the [[Mynock 7 Space Station]].<ref name="FC" />
